$comment: Versioned Signal contract for Python <-> C++ boundary. Any schema change increments $version below. Do not hand-maintain parallel definitions.
title: Signal
description: Schema v1: A single, versioned definition of what a trading signal looks like as it crosses from the Python research/agent layer into the C++ risk/execution layer.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must equal 1 in this phase. Consumers reject any other value.

cycle_id.description: UUID shared across all signals emitted in one orchestrator cycle (enables grouping/joining downstream).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of signal emission.

regime.description: Market regime at emission time. Must match a :Regime node name in master.cypher.

strategy.description: Strategy name that generated the signal.

venue.description: Execution venue. Must be consistent with asset_class per cross-check rules.

venue_symbol.description: Venue-specific symbol (Kraken pair like 'XLEUSD' or IBKR contract like 'XLE/SMART/USD').

asset_class.description: Asset class for routing and risk-parameter selection.

direction.description: Signal direction. 'hold' implies |score| below the fused-score threshold.

score.description: Final fused score after applying news_overlay and macro_overlay to the 70/30 quant/sentiment fusion.

quant_score.description: Quantitative model score (70% weight in fusion).

sentiment_score.description: LLM sentiment score (30% weight in fusion).

news_overlay.description: News sentiment boost/penalty applied to score. Bounded to [-1,1].

macro_overlay.description: Macro calendar pre-event size modifier applied to score. Bounded to [-1,1].

kg_formula_contribution.description: KG SignalGenerator formula evaluation contribution. Bounded to [-1,1].

graph_path.description: KG traversal path for audit trail. Currently emitted as a list of Concept node names by SignalAgent. The schema accepts any string array; downstream consumers should not assume alternating Concept/Relationship structure unless the emitter is updated.

contradiction_blocked.description: True if the signal was blocked by a CONTRADICTED_BY edge in the KG.
